title: Alaska and Hawaiian unwrap their biggest holiday sale ever
summary: The savings begin on Black Friday with up to 30% off flights to and from Hawaiʻi with code BF2026. Throughout Cyber Week, we’ll keep unwrapping new limited time offers. Bookmark this page and check back every day through Dec. 3 to find out what’s new.
